# ezghcloud_warehouse_connection (Resource)

A warehouse's connection to an Object Storage bucket, a Hosted Queues Kafka cluster or an EZGH Databases database, which SQL names as name: s3(name, …), ENGINE = Kafka(name), postgresql(name, …) or mysql(name, …). Creating it needs the target's own permissions: it adds the warehouse to the bucket's grants, or creates a read-only Kafka or database user whose password is kept in a Secret. A warehouse has one connection to each bucket. Kafka clusters and databases must be in the warehouse's VPC. Destroying it deletes the credential it created. A connection whose target was deleted is broken until destroyed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# SQL reads the bucket as s3(lake, filename = 'events/*.parquet').
resource "ezghcloud_warehouse_connection" "lake" {
  project_id   = ezghcloud_project.example.id
  warehouse_id = ezghcloud_warehouse.example.id
  name         = "lake"
  type         = "bucket"
  target_id    = "bkt_7hq2m0x9ka3c"
  access       = "read"
}

# A Kafka table engine reads topics starting clicks. as ENGINE = Kafka(clicks).
resource "ezghcloud_warehouse_connection" "clicks" {
  project_id   = ezghcloud_project.example.id
  warehouse_id = ezghcloud_warehouse.example.id
  name         = "clicks"
  type         = "kafka"
  target_id    = "hqc_4k2m9x0a7qpe"
  topic_prefix = "clicks."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name SQL uses: a lowercase letter, then up to 31 lowercase letters, digits and _. Names starting ezgh_ are reserved. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `project_id` (String) Project of the warehouse. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `target_id` (String) What it reaches: a bucket (bkt_), a Kafka cluster (hqc_) or a database (dbi_). Changing it replaces the connection.
- `type` (String) bucket, kafka or database. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `warehouse_id` (String) Warehouse (whs_) it belongs to. Changing it replaces the connection.

### Optional

- `access` (String) A bucket's access: read or readWrite (INSERT INTO FUNCTION s3(…) too). Required for a bucket, refused otherwise. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `database` (String) A database connection's logical database. Required for a database, refused otherwise. Changing it replaces the connection.
- `topic_prefix` (String) Kafka only: consume only topics starting with it, up to 200 of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, ., _ and -, in consumer groups whose names start with the username in secret_id. Every topic when unset. Changing it replaces the connection.

### Read-Only

- `failure_code` (String) Why the connection failed or broke, as a code; null when it didn't.
- `failure_message` (String) Why the connection failed or broke; null when it didn't.
- `id` (String) warehouse_id/name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `secret_id` (String) The Secret (sec_) holding a Kafka or database connection's user and password; null for a bucket.
- `status` (String) creating, available, broken (its target is gone), deleting or failed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_warehouse_connection.lake 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/WAREHOUSE_ID/NAME'
```
